news.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Launch of Triple Threat Series Including Memory ETF Featuring SanDisk
news.summary: Tradr ETFs announced the upcoming launch of a new 'Triple Threat' series of leveraged ETFs, which includes a fund providing 200% daily exposure to a basket of memory stocks, including SanDisk Corporation.

news.headline: SanDisk Chief Accounting Officer Discloses Stock Sale in SEC Filing
news.summary: Michael Pokorny, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of SanDisk, sold 26,016 shares of company stock in a transaction reported on November 25, 2026.

news.headline: Coherent Director Stephen G. Pagliuca Purchases $15.22 Million in Common Stock
news.summary: Coherent Corp. director Stephen G. Pagliuca acquired 82,000 shares of the company's common stock in a transaction dated November 20, 2026.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Coherent Price Target to $300 From $420
news.summary: BNP Paribas has revised its price target for Coherent Corp. shares, lowering it from $420 to $300.

news.headline: Bloom Energy Supports Nashville Students and Families
news.summary: Bloom Energy partnered with Nashville firefighters to support local students and families ahead of the Tennessee-Vanderbilt football game.
